title: Abbasid Caliphate
summary: Abbasid rule, at first imperial and later often symbolic, from the overthrow of the Umayyads to the Mongol sack of Baghdad.
body: Real power fragmented early. The cultural prestige of the caliphate outlasted its armies. Editorial draft for this timeline, not a substitute for specialist literature.

sources.name: Kennedy, When Baghdad Ruled the Muslim World
